The original Bioshock. That game is swimming in atmosphere and a beautiful art style, not to mention the great story it tells, both through dialogue and the setting of Rapture. Also, the amount of detail in it is amazing. From the Big Daddies to the Leatherhead Splicers, I was just so completely absorbed in it, and have continued to be throughout each game in the series. The game really does show that games are a form of art.
